description: On a graph with points (k, prime(k)), k>=1, consider if prime(n) is on any previously drawn infinite line between prime(j) and prime(j-1), where 2<=j<=n-1. If not, add one to the count of primes not on any such line, and then, regardless of if prime(n) is on a line, draw an infinite line between prime(n) and prime(n-1). The sequence gives the total number of primes not on any previously drawn infinite line, starting from prime(2).
